newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp signs wind energy project deal.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp signs wind energy project deal.

text.p: Officials from PacifiCorp, the Eugene Water and Electric Board and Seawest Energy announced Wednesday an agreement to develop a 41.4 megawatt (MW) wind turbine power project in Wyoming.
The project, set for Foote Creek Rim in Carbon County, Wyoming, is in the final stages of the permitting process.
Pending those approvals, construction will start in August, with the facility expected to begin operations by the end of 1998 or early 1999, PacifiCorp said.
Portland, Ore.-based PacfiCorp will be the primary owner of the project, which has total projected costs of $60 million.
